name: Beetroot juice and dietary nitrate
short: No serious adverse events in a 12-week trial in older adults; a review warns beetroot juice can push nitrate intake above the acceptable daily intake.
text: In a 12-week randomised placebo-controlled trial in older adults, a nitrate-rich beetroot extract caused no serious adverse events and no significant changes in body measurements, blood tests or haemodynamic measures. A systematic review noted that drinking beetroot juice can easily raise nitrate intake above the acceptable daily intake, which stimulates the body's formation of N-nitroso compounds, a class known to be carcinogenic, and that data on adverse effects are limited. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
